item.title: What the Meta Verdict Means for Small Business Owners (And Why Your Website Matters More Than Ever)
item.description: Something happened in a Los Angeles courtroom this week that many small business owners will have scrolled straight past. But if you use Instagram or Facebook to market your business, and most of us do, it is worth paying attention. On 25th March 2026, a jury found Meta (the parent company of Instagram and Facebook) and YouTube liable on every single count in a landmark trial over social media addiction.
